newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO official says progress in Hebron talks.
newsitem.headline: PLO official says progress in Hebron talks.

text.p: A senior PLO official said on Monday that Israeli and Palestinian negotiations had made headway in peace talks deadlocked over Hebron.
"There is progress," Mahmoud Abbas, also known as Abu Mazen, told reporters after meeting Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
Asked if an agreement had been reached, Abu Mazen said: "Not yet."
He said he had a letter for Palestinian President Yasser Arafat from Netanyahu.
Netanyahu met Abu Mazen after U.S. Middle East envoy Dennis Ross helped re-energise the stalled negotiations during meetings in Gaza on Sunday night.
PLO officials said the talks progressed and they hoped a deal could be clinched by Christmas.
